description: Apple Xcode environment architecture: Swift Package Manager (SPM) dependency graph, iOS/macOS Simulator management, Instruments performance profiling (Time Profiler, Leaks), and App Store archive signing.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Apple Xcode Architecture & Performance Profiling

Master Xcode for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS native app development, performance profiling, and release distribution.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Manage all external libraries through Swift Package Manager with exact semantic version pins.
- Run Xcode Instruments (Time Profiler and Leaks) on physical devices to eliminate performance bottlenecks.
- Decouple Development, Staging, and Production configurations into distinct Build Schemes.
- Maintain minimal entitlements and secure code signing identities for App Store distribution.
